items.body: `Err(_) => EvidenceMatch::Reject` discards evidence admission refusals. If snapshot projection returns Reach but typed evidence admission returns MalformedRequest or Unsupported, `reach()` returns `Ok(None)`. Judge then publishes Unexplained and commits a frozen run. Invalid evidence therefore becomes a model mismatch instead of a refusal, violating the task’s evidence validation contract.
items.suggestion: Preserve admission errors through the runtime’s Result path, keeping explicit predicate rejection separate. Add a control where projection succeeds and evidence admission fails; verify that Judge returns the original refusal without changing state, pending requests or retained history.
items.title: `Err(_) => EvidenceMatch::Reject` discards evidence admission refusals
